# Neutrino

Neutrino API provides a suite of general-purpose APIs for various tasks, including data validation, geolocation, and security.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/neutrino/.

## Actions

- **Convert Value** (read-only): Perform unit and currency conversions.
- **Geocode Address** (read-only): Geocode an address.
- **IP Info** (read-only): Retrieve ip location and network information.
- **IP Lookup** (read-only): Geolocate an ip address and retrieve isp, asn, blocklist, and threat metadata.
- **Reverse Geocode** (read-only): Convert geographic coordinates to a physical address.
- **SMS Verify**: Send a unique security code via sms.
- **URL Info** (read-only): Parse, analyze, and retrieve content from the supplied url.
- **Validate and analyze an email address** (read-only): Parse, validate, and clean an email address.
- **Verify Email Address** (read-only): Verify and analyze the deliverability of an email address.
- **Verify Security Code** (read-only): Verify a security code generated by the generate security code api.
- **Bad Word Filter** (read-only): Detect bad words and profanity in text.
- **BIN Lookup** (read-only): Perform a bin (bank iin) lookup.
- **HLR Lookup** (read-only): Perform real-time hlr lookup and mobile number validation.
- **Host Reputation** (read-only): Check the reputation of a host against dnsbls.
- **HTML Clean** (read-only): Clean and sanitize untrusted html.
- **HTML Render** (read-only): Render html content into png or pdf.
- **IP Probe** (read-only): Analyze an ip address to determine its threat level and associated risk factors.
- **Phone Validate** (read-only): Validate and lookup phone numbers.
- **QR Code** (read-only): Generate a qr code image from text or url.
- **Resize Image**: Resize, crop, and convert images.
- **UA Lookup** (read-only): Parse, validate, and get detailed user-agent information.
